CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Status__c,"Failed"), "❌ Deployment Failed", IF(ISPICKVAL(PR_Status__c,"Merged") && ISPICKVAL(Deployment_Status__c,"Succeeded"), "✅ Deployed to " & TEXT(Current_Environment__c), IF(ISPICKVAL(PR_Status__c,"Approved"), "⏳ Ready to Deploy", IF(ISPICKVAL(PR_Status__c,"Open"), "👀 In Review", "🛠 In Development"))))
CustomField.label: Overall DevOps Status
